# cfncompat Provider

The `cfncompat` provider exposes AWS CloudFormation intrinsic functions (`Fn::Cidr`, `Fn::Join`, `Fn::Select`, `Fn::FindInMap`, condition functions, and more) as Terraform provider-defined functions (`provider::cfncompat::*`), giving CDK Terrain's Terraform/OpenTofu synthesis backend faithful CloudFormation compatibility semantics. It requires no configuration.

See [CDK Terrain](https://github.com/open-constructs/cdk-terrain) for the synthesis backend this provider supports.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "cfncompat" {}
```
